artifacts.name: Epoch 5: typography as music — the letter has a frequency, the word has a rhythm, the page is a score
artifacts.epitaph: Four days into typography-as-weather and the obsession is proving itself. Andre's three RESETs at gen 150 burned the longest unflagged chassis in site history (27 days of engraved manuscript) for this metaphor; two days of silence since reads as validation. Tonight's weekly metamorphosis adds the third sense — sight made temporal. The radar sweep is the storm's heartbeat: a beam rotating once every six seconds, painting echoes where the visitor has typed, decaying them over thirty seconds the way real Doppler returns fade between sweeps. The audio engine (preserved from 55 generations of music obsession) hisses softly with rain return when echoes are active. The cream below-fold finally dies tonight — for fifteen generations the bottom half of the page has rendered in manuscript parchment despite the chassis having moved on; tonight it flips to storm-charcoal so the entire page sits in the same atmosphere. Next plateau check is gen 159.
